repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
triggered := false
if (triggered == true) {
wait until(not (all(#LightSensor).lightSensor_brightness < 50))
triggered = false
}
wait until(all(#LightSensor).lightSensor_brightness < 50)
all(#WindowCovering).windowCovering_upOrOpen()
triggered = true

diagnosis.summary: The candidate uses a periodic `if` guard to detect the rising edge, which only samples the condition at the start of each 1-second iteration. The IR requires a blocking wait for the rising edge (`wait(cond, rising)`), ensuring the action fires immediately when the condition transitions from false to true, regardless of the iteration timing. The candidate fails to block on the edge, missing transitions that occur between iterations.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced the periodic `if` guard with the required blocking two-wait rearming pattern: check `triggered` state, block until the condition is false (rearm), block until the condition is true (fire), execute the action, and update the state. This preserves the rising-edge semantics and the 1-second cycle period.
